Avoid unnecessary signs, text and people. Photorealistic garage scene, one compact electric car parked at right with charging flap CLOSED. At left a French grounded wall power socket, empty with its protective cover closed. In foreground a standard domestic extension cable reel on floor, clearly unplugged, with its loose grounded plug visible nearby; NO connection to car, socket or anything. No charging cable plugged in, no sparks, damage, warninglights or people. Realistic single reel cable topology, dry clean floor, no text, no logos, no labels. Everything disconnected before deciding how to arrange safe charging.

sources.supports: Renault instructions prohibit extension leads/adaptors/multiple sockets and require professional verification of domestic socket installation against charging specifications.
